prompt: In a photorealistic photo, the scene unfolds at a busy airport gate. On the left, a man in a red scarf stands holding a boarding pass. Next to him sits a woman in a blue coat on a metal chair. A brown dog rests its head on her knee, looking up at her face. The woman points toward a large digital screen displaying flight times. In the center, a child in a yellow jacket runs past a rolling suitcase with a broken wheel. A pilot in a crisp uniform walks briskly beside the child, glancing at a wristwatch. To the right, an elderly man in a tweed hat leans against a glass window, watching the tarmac. A flight attendant in a navy dress hands a small packet of peanuts to a teenager in headphones. The teenager smiles while accepting the snack. Behind them, a businessman in a grey suit types rapidly on a silver laptop balanced on his knees. A barista in a green apron places a steaming coffee cup on a high table next to the businessman. A toddler in pink overalls crawls under the high table, reaching for a dropped toy car. An older woman in a floral dress sits on a bench near the toddler, knitting with bright yarn. A security guard in a black vest stands near the entrance, observing the crowd with crossed arms. There is no snow visible outside the windows. There is no food court signage in the background.
